requirements.description: Query Alphabet FY2025 10-K for consolidated net cash provided by operating activities for fiscal years 2024 and 2025, reported actual, USD, no manual arithmetic.

Query Alphabet FY2025 10-K for cash payments to acquire property and equipment for fiscal years 2024 and 2025 as reported in the cash flow statement, reported actual, USD; also identify period and accounting basis.

Using the selected Alphabet FY2025 10-K, identify the major categories in which Alphabet invested in long-lived physical assets (property and equipment purchases), correlate the original table line for purchases of property and equipment with the narrative categories, and separate reported actual amounts from forward-looking statements. Read the relevant complete paragraphs and tables; do not treat search previews as read.
